• Ticket Manipulation: The only way to contact them is the app, but they keep cancelling/closing my service requests without any resolution. They simply cancel the ticket to avoid accountability.

• Lack of Access: There is absolutely no way to contact them easily. They have built a system specifically to hide from customers once they have collected the money.

• Unprofessional Staff: On the rare occasion I managed to connect with a representative, they were incredibly rude, arrogant, and dismissive of the fact that their product is causing harm. A Furlenco representative named Abrar finally came to inspect the product, but instead of fixing it, he damaged one of the chairs even further. Summary: Furlenco is happy to take your monthly rent but provides zero support when they deliver faulty, dangerous goods. I am now escalating this to the National Consumer Helpline.

featured_reviews.name: Hrishabh Sanghvi
featured_reviews.review_text:

Reasons:
1. Their sales person will lie/conveniently hide the terms and conditions while showing you around. Once you’ve paid the advance under the guise of "Security Deposit", then they’ll share the onerous T&C, which you simply have to deal with.
2. Their management is worse. You can approach them with your concerns but they resort to threats and keep your advance money hostage. Once you've paid, you will never get your deposit back, not to mention face constant irritants from their staff.
3. Basement has only 1 AC and they crank it up so high so that the conference room is cool that you'll freeze outside it. Staff doesn't help.
4. Men's washroom is smelly, despite repeated reminders
5. Staff was very rude to guests
6. Staff, service and terms are way below competitive co-working spaces, not hospitable at all.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience with Rentomojo.

I received a confirmation email stating that my order would be delivered on 5th June. However, on the delivery date itself, the app suddenly changed the delivery date to 8th June without any prior notice.

Customer support's response was simply "sorry," which does not solve the problem. Customers plan their moves based on the dates provided by Rentomojo, and last-minute changes cause unnecessary inconvenience. To make matters worse, additional delivery charges are being asked for despite already collecting a security deposit and other upfront payments.

Unprofessional service, poor communication, hidden costs, and unreliable delivery commitments. If timely delivery and transparency are important to you, think twice before renting from Rentomojo.
